precepts.text: Lord, thou hast heard the desire of the humble; thou wilt prepare their heart. Humble yourself to whatever the Bible says.
precepts.point: Ezra had prepared his heart, his mind, to seek the law of the Lord, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments. We are in captivity, working and tired, and the Most High reminds us these are the last days, so prepare your mind.

note.label: America At War With Iran: Preparation For Conflict

precepts.why:
“For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the Lord, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.” What is the heart? The mind. Ezra had prepared his mind to seek the Lord his God. We are in captivity, always working and tired; some days you get stressed. But the Most High has to remind us that we are living in the last days. So brothers, prepare your minds; sisters, prepare your minds.

David shows who the Lord prepares: “Lord, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear”. We are the humble. We are supposed to humble ourselves to whatever the Bible says we ought to do.

And when we humble ourselves, the Lord hears our desire and prepares our hearts. We will prepare our minds. That is what Ezra did before he went to teach Israel, and that is what is required of us now, as we watch Iran and Israel go to war and America get involved, and more of our people wake up and repent.

precepts.text: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him. They are watching those of us who keep the commandments, so walk right and be an example.
precepts.point: His eyes are privily set against the poor: the eye on the dollar, the surveillance that sees every site you visit and, through the ADL and the police systems, every bank account. He lieth in wait secretly as a lion to catch the poor when he draweth him into his net, and the poor fall by his strong ones, the police and the military.

note.label: Cyber Warfare: The Mouth Of The Beast

precepts.why:
Esau “hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.” The white man's mouth is full of cursing, deceit and fraud. “He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent”: that is Mossad and the CIA, the black sites where they would put us and kill us. And “his eyes are privily set against the poor”: the eye on the back of the dollar bill, and the social media and technology set up to monitor us. Every porn video you watch, every site you go on, the white man knows. The ADL monitors bank accounts, and even the police can see all that information. Everything is coming under one system.

David says it plainly: “The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.” Brothers and sisters, they are watching you. With the system they have set up they can tell everything you are doing. They are watching those of us who keep the commandments, who call ourselves Israelites. They know there are more than a million people in America who identify as Israelites and agree with these teachings.

And they seek to slay him: they want to destroy us. “He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor.” He wants to catch you slipping, clicking on the wrong thing. “He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones”: the government, the police, the military.

So walk right and be an example. Build yourselves up. If the wicked is watching the righteous, let him find nothing on you but the commandments of God.

precepts.text: Every day they wrest my words; they gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul. TikTok's new terms track your location and even immigration status.
precepts.point: His eyes are privily set against the poor: the eye on the dollar, the surveillance that sees every site you visit and, through the ADL and the police systems, every bank account. He lieth in wait secretly as a lion to catch the poor when he draweth him into his net, and the poor fall by his strong ones, the police and the military.

note.label: Cyber Warfare: The Mouth Of The Beast

precepts.why:
The wicked sits in the secret places and “his eyes are privily set against the poor.” David describes how they watch: “Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil. They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.”

They mark your steps: they watch everywhere you go. When you download TikTok now, you have to agree to terms that let them check your immigration status and follow your location wherever you go. The new terms are set up to monitor you and follow you. They want to destroy our soul.

Christ went through the same thing: “And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.” They watch us through these devices; even YouTube lets our channels stay up so they can monitor us. And they send spies who act righteous and act like they want to learn, sent by the federal government to set us up, plant something and lie on us, as they did in France, where conversations among the brothers showed up in the court case against a brother put out of the country.

That is why anything you say has to be scriptural; none of you should be saying dumb, stupid stuff, because they are waiting to wrest your words and deliver them to the government. And the one who takes that work for a little house and a little bank account condemns his soul forever. But the Lord “disappointeth the devices of the crafty”, and “he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth”: from the lies of their media.

precepts.text: Come down and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon (America); she says in her heart "I am, and none beside me," yet her nakedness shall be uncovered.
precepts.point: He says in his heart, "I shall never be in adversity." This is Esau saying his kingdom will last forever, naming America and Africa and the European countries after his ancestors.

note.label: Psalm 10: Why Standest Thou Afar Off, O Lord

precepts.why:
“He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.” This is Esau saying his kingdom will last forever, naming America and Africa and the European countries after his ancestors.

Isaiah heard the same boast from the virgin daughter of Babylon, which is America, and answered it: “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.” She is told, “Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers. Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” And the one doing it: “As for our redeemer, the Lord of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.”

God says why: “I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke. And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.” She was given Israel to hold, showed no mercy, and said she would be a lady for ever, never remembering the latter end.

Then the very words of the wicked in Psalm 10: “thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children”. She says in her heart, I am, and none beside me, yet her nakedness shall be uncovered. Through the pride of his countenance the wicked will not seek after God; he is thinking about money and how to destroy the Israelites and keep his kingdom going, not knowing he is only fulfilling the prophecy God said he would.

precepts.text: The Lord will have mercy on Jacob and choose Israel, and they shall rule over their oppressors and take captive those whose captives they were.
precepts.point: The Lord hears the desire of the humble and prepares their heart, causing his ear to hear, so as to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may oppress no more. The Israelites will not be oppressed anymore.

note.label: Psalm 10: Why Standest Thou Afar Off, O Lord

precepts.why:
“Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none. The Lord is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.” The so-called white man and the other nations must be put down so the Lord can flourish, because Christ shares no throne with the other nations; America is not moving out of the way for Christ's kingdom. The so-called jewish, whom the bible calls bastards dwelling in Ashdod, the Lord will root out of his land.

Isaiah shows the day: “For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob. And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.” The Lord will have mercy on Jacob and choose Israel, and they shall take captive those whose captives they were and rule over their oppressors.

“And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve”. That is the Lord hearing the desire of the humble and judging the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may oppress no more. The Israelites will not be oppressed anymore.

precepts.text: The wicked boasts of his heart's desire and blesses the covetous, whom the Most High abhors, and will not seek after God.
precepts.point: The transgression of the wicked says there is no fear of God before his eyes, for he flatters himself in his own eyes. He boasts himself up: nobody could take me down.

note.label: Psalm 36: The Transgression of the Wicked

precepts.why:
“The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes. For he flattereth himself in his own eyes”. He boasts himself up: nobody could take me down. Psalm 10 shows the same wicked one: “For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the Lord abhorreth.” He boasts, he blesses the covetous whom the Most High abhors, and he will not seek after God; there is no fear of God before his eyes.

“The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.” The wickedness of this nation gets worse and worse. People who have changed what the Most High made them are now over the educational system, showing children sexual things they are not even supposed to know exist. Yet those same children they say are not fit to choose which parent they want to be with; they put up laws and red tape to keep a child from the parent they want to be around.

precepts.text: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten, he hideth his face, he will never see it; that is why they say it is all in the past, that you are stuck in the Old Testament.
precepts.point: A lot of people, especially the wicked Esau and those Christians, say the Most High has forgotten and hides his face.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

precepts.why:
“For the Lord loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.” The wicked believe the opposite: “He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.” That is why they say it is all in the past, that you are stuck in the Old Testament. A lot of people, especially the wicked Esau and those Christians, say the Most High has forgotten and hides his face.

But the Most High forsakes not his saints. Everything the wicked and their seed have done, they are still going to pay for. Even after Christ we went through slavery and all types of wicked punishments at the hand of our enemies, and he did not forget that they are wicked and that payback is coming to them. “The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever”, with the law of his God in his heart, and none of his steps shall slide.
